content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy provides a streamlined platform for selling digital products, but it is limited by geographic restrictions. Stripe operates in only 46 out of 195 countries, severely limiting access for creators in many regions. PayPal has its own set of challenges, including account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructures like COREMERCH enable creators to set up their own online stores without reliance on these platforms, ensuring they maintain full control over their sales.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and Stripe are known for their geographic limitations, essentially barring creators from countries such as Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan from accessing their services. This creates a frustrating environment where creators are left with few options. PayPal's stringent policies further complicate matters, as many creators face account limitations or suspensions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, offers a solution by allowing creators to build their own platforms that are not subject to these external restrictions. This means that regardless of location, creators can sell their digital products seamlessly.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, Lemon Squeezy and Stripe can impose high fees and lengthy transaction times, especially for international sales. PayPal adds another layer of complexity with its fee structure and potential fund holds. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions like COREMERCH utilize NOWPayments, which offers a mere 0.5% fee and immediate payment confirmations on-chain. This efficient payment processing means creators can get paid quickly, without the hidden costs associated with traditional platforms.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure puts creators back in control.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of data and products is a crucial consideration for digital creators. With Lemon Squeezy, creators often relinquish control over their customer data, while Stripe and PayPal have restrictive policies that can complicate ownership. Sovereign commerce solutions ensure that once deployed, creators own everything and have full access to their customer interactions. Automated delivery processes can be established through platforms like COREMERCH, enabling creators to deliver products instantly without relying on external systems.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture depends on your specific needs. If you're in a restricted country, platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Stripe are not viable options. Instead, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offered by COREMERCH, which can be deployed in just 48 hours. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, allowing you to quickly set up a fully functional online store. Evaluate your product type and customer base to determine the best fit for your sovereign commerce setup.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No more waiting for payment approvals — get paid instantly.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
